name: lorvel-plugins
description: Lorvel's Claude Code plugins — commands for creating, planning, splitting and working Lorvel tasks

plugins.name: lorvel
plugins.description: Create, plan, split and work Lorvel tasks from chat: /lorvel:task-create writes a task from a description, /lorvel:task-plan plans it, /lorvel:task-split splits it into subtasks you approve, /lorvel:task-work works it through to closing
